class.name: NetwNativeTests
class.brief_description: The one class a test build adds, so a headless driver can reach the embedded native suite.
class.description: Builds that do not compile the suite in do not carry this class, and nothing outside the test build names it.

method.name: instrumentation_probe
method.description: Exercises every profiling and tracing macro once with [param value], so a build can confirm its instrumentation compiles and fires without a real workload driving it.

method.name: run
method.description: Runs the embedded doctest suite, scoped to [param filter] when it is not empty, and writes its JUnit results to [param report_path]. A non-empty [param cells_path] also writes the law-matrix cell manifest there. Answers a [Dictionary] echoing the three params back plus [code]exit_code[/code] and the total cell count.

method.name: wire_spec
method.description: The wire registry's specification as data: [code]records[/code], [code]channels[/code], [code]reserved[/code] ranges, and the default registry's [code]identity[/code] hash. [code]reserved[/code] names ids a build refuses to reclaim: a retired channel that read as merely absent could be handed to a new one, and two versions would then agree on an id and disagree on everything under it.
